svg.text: AI USE POLICY
Use AI as a learning tool, not a shortcut.
ALLOWED — WHEN IT SUPPORTS LEARNING
✓ Ask for explanations in simpler words.
✓ Ask for debugging ideas, hints, or test strategies.
✓ Review code, pseudocode, or engineering reasoning.
✓ Generate practice questions or compare approaches.
✓ Use suggestions only after you test and verify them.
NOT ALLOWED — AI CANNOT DO THE LEARNING FOR YOU
✕ Submit AI-generated work you do not understand.
✕ Ask AI to complete the entire task and claim it as your own.
✕ Hide meaningful AI use when disclosure is required.
✕ Invent measurements, test results, observations, or robot performance.
REQUIRED — YOU OWN THE RESULT
• Understand and explain your code, build, logic, and decisions.
• Test AI suggestions on the real robot or system.
• Rebuild key patterns when asked.
• Record meaningful AI assistance in your evidence.
• Use physical tests and measured data as proof — not AI output.
Disclosure: What I asked AI · How it helped · How I verified it · What I did myself
AI can help you think.
It cannot replace your testing, understanding, or engineering responsibility.
